description: The saved LZ diagram document, as useLzWorkspace.js normalizes it: current v2 diagrams, legacy flat snapshots, API records (lz_data) and whole workspaces. Graphics are opaque objects the normalizer copies without reading, so fields it does not know survive. Timestamps and ids are always supplied (the web falls back to the clock and a random id).
